summary: Verify canary application-image signatures against the reusable workflow that actually performs the trusted signing operation.
security: Cosign verification remains pinned to the repository, main ref, GitHub Actions OIDC issuer, and exact reusable signer workflow.
documentation: The canary workflow is the executable operator record for its trusted signer identity; no external procedure changes.
rollback: Revert the expected identity only if signing responsibility moves out of the reusable image workflow.
validation: The canary workflow contract test rejects the caller workflow as the expected application-image signer.
A protected canary must verify both signed image manifests before release resumes.
